tagline: Build reputation. Earn XP. Compete transparently.
description: A 14-day verified participation and holder-acquisition campaign powered by Project Q and the CrabStar Oracle.

releases.label: Verified activity
releases.detail: Recurring release after each 48-hour cycle is verified

releases.label: Post-review
releases.detail: September 18 if cleared at 48 hours; otherwise immediately upon clearance by September 19

releases.label: Phased
releases.detail: Five 5% releases at 6-day intervals across 30 days after post-review release

missions.title: Oracle X Raids
missions.description: Verified likes, reposts, replies, quote posts and bookmarks.
missions.verification: Oracle verifies each accepted X action. Project Q settles 4 XP per action inside the 20 XP mission cap and 75 XP overall daily cap.
requirements: Verified Telegram and Oracle X identity
Enter through the official Oracle raid flow
Pass action, timing and replay verification

missions.title: Website Voting
missions.description: Certified listing votes with cooldown tracking.
missions.verification: Each accepted voting source awards 1 XP. Completing every currently available source adds a one-time 2 XP bonus, subject to the shared participation and overall caps.
requirements: Use a source registered by Project Q
Complete the source-specific cooldown and evidence check
Duplicate or unavailable-source submissions do not count

missions.title: Trending Bots
missions.verification: Each accepted confirmation from a registered Telegram trending bot awards 2 XP, up to 8 XP daily and within the shared 15 XP participation cap.
requirements: Use one of the four registered bots
Submit an authentic completion confirmation
Origin, FAWKQ context, timing and uniqueness must verify

missions.title: Bagwork
missions.description: Complete approved platform tasks and earn SOL.
missions.verification: The Bagwork backend records creator clearance, approved submissions, the applicable measurement window and confirmed payouts.
requirements: Apply for clearance before creating the content
Follow the live task brief and platform requirements
Only confirmed Bagwork records receive payout or campaign credit

missions.title: Buy-to-Earn
missions.description: Track finalized net buys through approved markets.
missions.verification: Project Q calculates finalized eligible buys minus eligible sells through approved markets. Tier 1 starts at 0.07 SOL net buy; Tier 2 starts at 0.20 SOL.
requirements: Verified reward wallet and FAWKQ token account
Finalized activity through approved markets
Transfers, OTC activity, rewards and manipulation are excluded

missions.title: Participation XP
missions.description: Settle verified campaign participation into your auditable Project Q XP record.
missions.verification: This is the combined Project Q record—not a separate submission. Accepted missions settle into an append-only XP ledger with 15 participation, 20 mission and 75 overall XP daily caps.
requirements: Complete an eligible mission through its official flow
Wait for source verification and Project Q settlement
Pending or rejected evidence awards no XP

missions.title: Community Pulse
missions.description: Earn daily XP through sustained, meaningful participation in the official FAWKQ community.
missions.verification: Qualify with 5 useful messages across 3 separate 30-minute windows, 2 genuine replies and at least a 2-hour activity span. Daily Top 5 bonuses can raise the award from 2 XP to 8 XP.
requirements: Participate in the configured official FAWKQ community
Commands, bots, repeated text and low-content messages do not count
Project Q stores a content fingerprint rather than raw message text

missions.title: Verified Referrals
missions.description: Invite a new participant who verifies, buys at least $2 of FAWKQ and earns verified XP.
missions.verification: First-touch attribution records the referral. Qualification requires a new participant, verified Telegram/X/wallet identity, a verified post-referral FAWKQ purchase of at least $2 and later positive campaign XP.
requirements: Share your personal opaque Project Q referral link
The referred participant must complete every qualification stage
Self-referrals, duplicate identities and recycled wallets do not qualify

missions.title: Earn to Burn
missions.description: Every verified campaign XP advances shared burn milestones and public receipts.
missions.verification: One settled campaign XP advances one append-only collective progress unit. Only the separate 15,000,000 FAWKQ creator-wallet reserve is designated for approved milestone burns.
requirements: Milestone terms and rules hash must be published
Two founders independently approve the same immutable proposal
Every executed burn must reconcile on-chain and publish a receipt
